newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Valencia sells 5-,10-yr bonds at lower yield.
newsitem.headline: Spain Valencia sells 5-,10-yr bonds at lower yield.

text.p: Spanish regional government of Valencia (Generalitat de Valencia) allotted a total of 5.8 billion pesetas in five- and ten-year bonds at a public auction on Tuesday, the regional government said.
Yields for the five-year bonds fell sharply versus the previous auction on November 19. They are a new tranche of an old issue.
The 10-year bond is a totally new issue.
ISSUE Yields Pvs Price Pvs Bid Allocated
NOTE - Moody's long term debt rating for Generalitat de Valencia is Aa3. At the end of September 1996 the region's total debt was 449 billion pesetas of which 205 billion was outstanding bonds.
